method: Deterministic raster alpha/ink contour trace, 4x interpolated boundary, 0.18 source-pixel simplification; no typeface substitution.
normalized_coordinates: x and y centred on the fixed reference crop, y up; full crop width/height are 1.

sunwin.scope: Physical central S-shaped paired arrow only. Chrome rounded frame explicitly excluded and modelled independently.
sunwin.trace_threshold: Grey linear blend 0.26..0.41; largest 4-connected component, preserving antialiased edge.

triangulation: Shapely 2.2 even-odd polygon normalization followed by mapbox-earcut 2.1, baked vertices/indices; no build-time dependency.
